messages:
nina: Quick alert: partner uploaded an old staging bundle to their public bucket. Its KMS-encrypted but includes Vault transit ciphertext in the payload and a manifest listing svc IDs. No plaintext keys seen but treat as exposure.

sec-bot: Incident created INC-20260325-09  severity=high  owner=eng-security

omar: path pls? can they read/write it now?

nina: s3://partner-drops/public/staging_bundle_2026-03-25.tar.gz
files: staging/creds.kms, staging/manifest.json (manifest lists: svc_acc=staging-replay, staging-agent; vault_path=secret/data/staging/agent; kms_key=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/old-xyz)
They had public read earlier; partner says ACL was accidental and now removed.

ravi: Immediate plan: 1) quarantine copy into our quarantine bucket 2) enable detailed Vault audit for secret/data/staging/agent forwarded to splunk for 90d 3) create dedicated KMS key for rewrap + grant 4) temp RBAC deny to all non-ci-staging principals.

sarah: I copied object to s3://redwood-quarantine/3678901234/ and applied object-lock. Set lifecycle TTL 48h.

ops-jen: I'll enable audit sink and draft the casbin deny policy. Draft deny rule: subject !in team:ci-staging -> deny read secret/data/staging/agent. Will push via infra pipeline with immediate rollout.

omar: For vault snapshot (redacted) run: 
```
vault kv get -format=json secret/data/staging/agent | jq 'del(.data.data.password)' > /tmp/staging-agent-snap.json
aws s3 cp /tmp/staging-agent-snap.json s3://redwood-audit-buckets/snapshots/3678901234.json --sse aws:kms
```
Make sure bucket ACL is sec-team-only and TTL 72h.

ravi: KMS approach: create kms-red-rotor-staging, policy restrict to ops-subnet and allow only ReEncrypt/Decrypt. Use aws kms re-encrypt on the blob and do not return ciphertext to partner; instead issue fresh creds.

sarah: Agree do not return. Partner must delete their copy and provide deletion proof (s3 delete marker + object version). We'll require signed attestation from partner security.

ops-jen: RBAC deny drafted and ready to apply. Pull request opened: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/9876 (rollout=immediate).

omar: Quick audit query to check historical reads: 
```
jq 'select(.type=="request" and .data.request.path=="secret/data/staging/agent") | {time:.time, accessor:.data.auth.accessor, op:.data.request.operation}' /var/log/vault/audit.log | uniq -c
```
Run and paste any unknown accessors.

nina: Ran it, two accessors show partner-ci-consumer-2 and one unknown 'b2f9c'. Forwarded full logs to splunk and attached to INC-20260325-09.

ravi: I'll create the KMS key now and run re-encrypt. ETA ~20m. After rewrap, we'll rotate any long-lived tokens and revoke old accessors.

sec-bot: INC-20260325-09 update: responder=ravi, kms_key=creating, quarantine=true, audit_forwarding=enabled

sarah: Scheduling 15m call with partner security + oncall in 30m to coordinate deletion proof and credential rotation.

nina: Checklist: quarantine, snapshot, audit-forward, kms-grant pending, rewrap planned, RBAC deny in PR, token rotation pending, partner deletion proof pending. I'll update incident when rewrap completes.
